description: This file defines a PHP class 'Item' within the Opencart system, specifically related to the catalog extension for shipping. The class provides a method 'getQuote' that calculates shipping costs for items in a shopping cart based on geographic zones and configuration settings.

classes.name: Item
classes.description: Represents a shipping method based on individual items, providing cost estimation based on cart contents and configuration.

methods.name: getQuote
methods.description: Calculates and returns shipping quote details for items in the cart based on address, configuration, and geographic zone.
